answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. A new agent locks a 50-unit deposit in escrow and records a fingerprint of work, like a juniper rooting through seasons, not a comet flashing and vanishing. After 20 matching epochs the deposit unlocks; a mismatch freezes it and peers slash 30%. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 units locked 20 epochs; an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards on the mesa of steady work.
